## Table 1 — OPERATOR config slots (facade → control)

These slots carry operator-visible setpoints and mode choices.
Each facade slot must be **linked facade→control** (the facade is the SOURCE, not the TARGET).

| Facade slot | Workbench display name | Target RT slot | Full ord | Physical instance / crossing notes |
|-------------|------------------------|----------------|----------|-------------------------------------|
| `temperatureSetpoint` | Setpoint de temperatura | _(fill)_ | _(fill)_ | |

## Table 2 — SUMMARY display slots (control → facade)

These slots display telemetry linked FROM the control module.
Each facade slot must be **linked control→facade** (the control point is the SOURCE).
A slot the component sets itself (timer anchor, computed status) is not linked: write `self` in its
Source RT slot cell. lint-link-target-flags.sh treats a row as a link-in target only once its source is filled.

| Facade slot | Workbench display name | Source RT slot | Full ord | Physical instance / crossing notes |
|-------------|------------------------|----------------|----------|-------------------------------------|
| `roomTemperature` | Temperatura del cuarto | _(fill)_ | _(fill)_ | |
| `doorOpen` | _(no lexicon key)_ | _(fill)_ | _(fill)_ | |

## Per-instance commissioning checklist (BUILD-LOOP §6.b)

Run after wiring, before operator hand-off:

- [ ] Every OPERATOR config slot linked facade→control (not to a display slot, not to a link-target side)
- [ ] Every SUMMARY display slot linked control→facade
- [ ] Physical mapping / crossing documented in the Notes columns above
- [ ] Config sanity: interval > duration, setpoints ≠ 0, hasDefrost=true AND airDefrost=true on air-defrost units
- [ ] After hot reload: triage-console.sh clean (no own-module load failures)
- [ ] After hot reload: bog-audit.sh CHECK11 clean (proxy-link fallback set)
- [ ] obix-nav.py facade<->rt link batch audit: all expected links present and values in range

public final class BRoomFacade extends BComponent {
}
-- fx/BRoomFacade.java --
package demo;
import javax.baja.sys.*;

// BRoomFacade: one OPERATOR config slot (facade->control) + one SUMMARY display slot (control->facade).
// Used by generate-wiring-map.bats to verify Table 1 and Table 2 extraction.
@NiagaraType
public final class BRoomFacade extends BComponent {

  // OPERATOR config slot — facade → control direction
  @NiagaraProperty(
    name = "temperatureSetpoint",
    flags = "Flags.SUMMARY|Flags.OPERATOR",
    defaultValue = "BDouble.make(-5.0)"
  )
  private BDouble temperatureSetpoint;

  // SUMMARY display slot — control → facade direction (no OPERATOR)
  @NiagaraProperty(
    name = "roomTemperature",
    flags = "Flags.SUMMARY",
    defaultValue = "BStatusNumeric.make(0.0)"
  )
  private BStatusNumeric roomTemperature;
}
